# Packing and carriage

Carriage is charged at cost for trade counter customers.

- Orders under 40 kg: 9.50 per consignment
- Orders of 40 kg or more: 24.00 per consignment
- Pallet deliveries are quoted per run

Packing materials are not refundable.
files.terms/terms-of-sale.md:
# Ferngrove Apiaries - terms of sale

Effective 1 March 2026. These conditions are printed on every sales confirmation.

## 5. Payment

Trade accounts are invoiced on dispatch. Late payment suspends further dispatch.

## 6. Returns and refunds

6.1 Stock goods ordered from the catalogue may be returned within 30 days of delivery.
6.2 Anything shown against a build number on the confirmation is cut, drilled or assembled to the customer's specification and may be returned within 21 days of delivery.
6.3 Queen bees and nucleus colonies are not returnable.
6.4 Refunds are paid to the original payment method once the goods are back at the yard.

## 7. Warranty

Extractors and uncapping tanks carry a two-year warranty against faulty workmanship.
